description: Aircraft, passenger and cargo movements at Jordanian airports is a series of data sets listed in opendata.gov.jo, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport Regulatory Authority (Civil Aviation Regulatory Commission). Statistical Report Year 2020 Aircraft Movement, Passenger Movement,Cargo, Mail Volume and Aircraft Overflying Jordan. Coverage: Jordan. The portal lists 2 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Transport Regulatory Authority (Civil Aviation Regulatory Commission). Its tags are Aircraft Movement Passenger Movement  Cargo Mail Volume. It offers 1 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2025-07-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Jordonian License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and air transport studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-jo-portal.
